items.question: What prescribed action follows situating the forehead syllable mass and worshipping the god?
premises: Hundred thousand is to be done.
items.inference: The verse links situating, counting, and divine worship in one rite.
uncertainties: Exact ritual referent of the forehead syllable mass remains unclear.
items.plain_english: Having situated the forehead syllable mass, having done a hundred thousand, O god-worshipped.
